channel.title: Claude News
channel.description: News, announcements, and stories from Anthropic about Claude and the people building with it.

item.title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise

item.description: Our new Claude for Nonprofits plugin brings new skills to every verified nonprofit organization, taking on the operational work that stretches small teams across fundraising, marketing, and hiring.

item.title: Claude for Financial Advisors
item.description: Financial advisors can now connect Claude to the custodians, portfolio platforms, CRMs, and planning tools they depend on, along with new skills tailored to the daily work of a financial advisor.

item.title: Manage costs and demonstrate ROI for Claude Code on Google Cloud
item.description: Best practices for managing costs and measuring return on investment for Claude Code on Google Cloud.

item.title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
item.description: Claude for Legal now includes ready-to-use artifacts for legal work that teams can adapt with their own data and connectors, and share across the business.

item.title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
item.description: IDC integrated Claude as part of its Quanta platform, and it has rolled Claude out across its own business

item.title: Smart reports, surveys, and pooled group budgets for Claude Enterprise
item.description: In many organizations, members have identified the unique work that Claude can unlock. The next step is expanding that work to every team.

item.title: Make long-running agents faster with message threads
item.description: New in the Messages API, send your conversation once, and the API receives only what’s new with every turn.
